qh: एक विशुद्ध सैद्धांतिक आदर्श गैस के लिए 'संपीड्यता गुणांक' ($Z = PV/nRT$) का मान क्या होता है?
e: Compressibility factor Z = PV/nRT batata hai ki vastavik gas ideal gas (Z = 1) se kitna alag hai; purely theoretical ideal gas ke liye, jisme anuon ke beech na aakarshan hota hai aur unka aayatan bhi shunya mana jaata hai, Z ki value exactly 1 hoti hai. Vastavik gasen kam dabav par Z < 1 (aakarshan ke karan) aur zyada dabav par Z > 1 (aayatan ke karan) dikhati hain, isliye Z ka ideal maan 0, -1 ya infinite nahi ho sakta. Isi karan Z se inter-atomic force aur aayatan ka pata lagta hai. Exam point: ideal gas ke liye compressibility factor Z = 1 hota hai; vastavik gasen Z deviating ke saath ideal se hat ti hain (van der Waals correction).

qe: Which physical parameter is the ONLY factor that can alter the numerical value of an Equilibrium Constant (K)?
qh: कौन सा भौतिक मापदंड एकमात्र ऐसा कारक है जो साम्य स्थिरांक (K) के संख्यात्मक मान को बदल सकता है?
e: Agyakarm constant (K) ka maan sirf ek hi chiz badal sakti hai - temperature; kyunki K forward aur reverse rate constants ka anupat hota hai aur dono rate constants temperature par nirbhar karte hain, isliye tapman badalne par K ka maan badal jaata hai. Sandrata, dabav, volume ya catalyst badalne se agyakarm khisak to sakta hai par K ka maan wahi rehta hai (Q badalta hai, K nahi). Isi liye catalyst ke upasthiti mein bhi K ka value na hai na ghata hai. Exam point: equilibrium constant K ka maan sirf temperature badalne par badalta hai; concentration, pressure aur catalyst se K par koi asar nahi hota.

qe: What is the 'Common Ion Effect' in aqueous electrolyte equilibrium?
qh: जलीय विद्युत-अपघट्य साम्य में 'समान आयन प्रभाव' (Common Ion Effect) क्या होता है?
o: Suppression of the degree of dissociation of a weak electrolyte by adding a strong electrolyte having a common ion
e: Common ion effect kehta hai ki yadi ek durbal vidyutapghatak (weak electrolyte) ke ghulaimaan mein wahi ion dene wala koi mazbut vidyutapghatak (strong electrolyte) mila diya jaaye, to durbal vidyutapghatak ka apghatan (dissociation) ghat jaata hai - kyunki Le-Chatelier's principle ke anusar adhik ion hone par agyakarm peeche (undissociated) disha mein khisak jaata hai. Isi karan acetic acid mein sodium acetate daalne par H+ ki sandrata ghat jaati hai aur pH badh jaata hai (buffer ka aadhaar). Sandrata badhana, pH girana ya rang badalna iske parinaam nahi hain, inhe is prashn mein sahi nahi maana jaata. Exam point: common ion effect = saman ion wala strong electrolyte daalne par weak electrolyte ka dissociation aur ionisation ghat jaata hai (jaise H2S + HCl se S2- kam hota hai).

qe: What is the relationship between pH and pOH in any aqueous solution at 25°C?
qh: 25°C पर किसी भी जलीय विलयन में pH और pOH के बीच क्या संबंध होता है?
e: Paani mein H+ aur OH- ki sandrata ka gunaank Kw = 10^-14 hota hai, isliye uske rin-log (negative log) lete hi pKw = 14 milta hai - matlab pH aur pOH ka jod hamesha 14 hoga (25 degree C par). Udaharan: agar pH 4 hai to pOH 10 hoga aur agar pH 10 hai to pOH 4. Dhyan rakhein: ye jod sirf 25 degree C par 14 hota hai; doosre tapman par Kw badalne se ye jod badal jaata hai (phir bhi pH + pOH = pKw). pH x pOH = 14, pH - pOH = 14 ya pH = pOH jaise sambandh galat hain. Exam point: 25 degree C par kisi bhi jaliya ghulaimaan mein pH + pOH = 14 (yaani pH + pOH = pKw) hota hai.

qe: What is the standard 'Molar Volume' occupied by exactly 1 mole of any ideal gas at STP (0°C and 1 atm)?
qh: STP (0°C और 1 atm) पर किसी भी आदर्श गैस के ठीक 1 मोल द्वारा घेरा गया मानक 'मोलर आयतन' कितना होता है?
e: STP (0 degree C yaani 273.15 K aur 1 atm dabav) par 1 mol kisi bhi ideal gas ka aayatan 22.4 L hota hai, kyunki V = nRT/P = (1 x 0.0821 x 273)/1 = 22.4 L nikalta hai - isi karan ise 'gram molar volume' bhi kehte hain aur isse mol se litre mein badalna aasaan hota hai. Dhyan rakhein: NTP/SATP (1 bar, 25 degree C) par ye maan 24.8 L ho jaata hai, isliye 22.4 L sirf STP ke liye hai. 11.2, 44.8 (do mol) aur 24.4 aankde STP ke liye galat hain. Exam point: STP (0 degree C, 1 atm) par 1 mol ideal gas ka molar volume 22.4 L hota hai; 1 mol ke aadha mol ke liye 11.2 L.

qe: What is the effect of adding an 'Inert Gas' at CONSTANT VOLUME to a gaseous equilibrium system?
qh: एक गैसीय साम्यावस्था निकाय में स्थिर आयतन पर 'अक्रिय गैस' मिलाने का क्या प्रभाव होता है?
o: Has no effect on the equilibrium position
e: Agyakarm par inert (nishtkriya) gas milane se jab aayatan sthir rahe, tab kisi bhi gas ka aanshik dabav (partial pressure) nahi badalta - kyunki kul dabav bhi badh jaata hai par ngRT wala sambandh wahi rehta hai (aayatan sthir hai), isliye agyakarm ki disha par koi asar nahi padta. Iske ulat, sthir dabav par inert gas milane se aayatan badhta hai (samikaran kamzoor pad jaata hai) aur ng wali disha mein agyakarm khisak jaata hai. Isliye 'aage badhta hai', 'peeche badhta hai' ya 'K badal jaata hai' wale vikalp galat hain. Exam point: sthir volume par inert gas milane se aanshik dabav aur K nahi badalte, isliye equilibrium par koi asar nahi hota.

qe: The Root Mean Square velocity ($v_{rms}$) of gas molecules is mathematically proportional to:
qh: गैस अणुओं का वर्ग माध्य मूल वेग ($v_{rms}$) गणितीय रूप से किसके समानुपाती होता है?
e: Kinetic theory ke anusar gas ke anuon ki root mean square speed (vrms) ka sutra vrms = sqrt(3RT/M) hai, isliye tapman badhane par ye gati vargmul-tapman (sqrt T) ke anupat badhti hai, yaani tapman 4 guna karne par gati sirf 2 guna badhti hai. Dhyan rakhein: vrms, average speed aur most probable speed teeno sqrt T ke samanupati hote hain, isliye 300 K se 1200 K jaane par gati dugni hogi. R x T, T x T ya log T wale sambandh galat hain. Exam point: vrms proportional to sqrt(T/M) - gati tapman ke vargmul aur mol-bhaar ke vyutkram vargmul par nirbhar karti hai.

qe: According to the Bronsted-Lowry acid-base theory, an 'Acid' is defined as a:
qh: ब्रोंस्टेड-लोरी अम्ल-क्षार सिद्धांत के अनुसार, एक 'अम्ल' को किस रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है?
e: Bronsted-Lowry theory acid-base ko proton (H+ ion) ke aadan-pradan se batati hai: acid wo hai jo proton (H+) deta hai aur base wo jo proton leta hai; isliye HCl paani mein H+ dekar hydronium ion banata hai. Isi paribhasha se sandrata-acid (conjugate acid-base) ke jode bante hain (jaise NH4+ ka joda NH3 hai). Lewis theory electron-pair wali hai, Arrhenius theory sirf jaliya H+/OH- wali hai - isliye 'electron acceptor', 'hydrogen de' ya 'neutralize' wale vikalp is theory ke naam hain hi nahi. Exam point: Bronsted-Lowry ke anusar acid = proton (H+) donor aur base = proton acceptor; ye paribhasha sandrata (conjugate) ke jode banaati hai.

qe: What is the total translational 'Kinetic Energy' of 1 mole of an ideal gas at temperature T?
qh: तापमान T पर एक आदर्श गैस के 1 मोल की कुल स्थानांतरीय 'गतिज ऊर्जा' क्या होती है?
e: Anuon ki sirf translational (sthaniy) gati ko dekhte hue kinetic theory bataati hai ki ek molecule ki ausat gati urja (3/2)kT hoti hai; isliye 1 mol ke liye (N anu, N x k = R) ye (3/2)RT ho jaati hai. Isi karan kisi bhi matra mein amu ki urja gas ke tapman se seedha judi hoti hai (KE proportional to T) aur tapman hi ausat kinetic energy ka maap ban jaata hai. (3/2)kT, RT, ya (5/2)RT wale aankde thos padarth ya anya swatantrata-koti (degrees of freedom) ke liye hote hain, isliye mole ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: 1 mol ideal gas ki kul translational kinetic energy = (3/2)RT hoti hai (per molecule (3/2)kT), kyunki usme teen degrees of freedom hote hain.

qe: What is the 'Conjugate Base' of the ammonium cation ($NH_4^+$)?
qh: अमोनियम धनायन ($NH_4^+$) का 'संयुग्मी क्षार' (Conjugate Base) क्या है?
e: Nh4+ (ammonium) ion ek proton (H+) chhodkar apna sandrata (conjugate) base bana leta hai; jab usme se H+ nikalta hai to NH3 bachta hai, isliye ammonium ka conjugate base ammonia (NH3) hai. Ulta NH3 proton lekar NH4+ bana leta hai, isliye NH3 ammonium ka conjugate acid hota hai. Ammonium hydroxide ya ammonium nitrate aise jode nahi hain kyunki unmein NH4+ ka koi proton-adan-pradan sambandh nahi dikhta. Exam point: NH4+ ka conjugate base NH3 hai (ek proton kam); aur NH3 ka conjugate acid NH4+ hota hai - ye Bronsted acid-base joda hai.

qe: What is the calculated 'pH' of a strong basic solution with $[OH^-] = 10^{-4}$ M at 25°C?
qh: 25°C पर $[OH^-] = 10^{-4}$ M वाले एक प्रबल क्षारीय विलयन का परिकलित 'pH' मान क्या है?
e: pOH = -log[OH-] = -log(10^-4) = 4 hota hai, aur 25 degree C par pH + pOH = 14 hone ke karan pH = 14 - 4 = 10 nikalta hai - isliye ye ghulaimaan kshariya (basic) hai (pH 7 se adhik). Isi tarah pOH nikal kar pH ka hisaab lagana weak/strong base ke liye aam vidhi hai (strong base mein [OH-] seedha diya hota hai). pH 4 to us acid wale ghulaimaan ka hota hai jismein [H+] = 10^-4 M ho, pH 6 aur 14 aise aankde nahi milte. Exam point: [OH-] = 10^-4 M wale ghulaimaan ka pOH 4 aur pH 10 hota hai (pH + pOH = 14).

qe: In modern electronic theory, what is 'Oxidation' defined as?
qh: आधुनिक इलेक्ट्रॉनिक सिद्धांत में 'ऑक्सीकरण' (Oxidation) को किस रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है?
e: Aadhunik paribhasha ke anusar oxidation wo kriya hai jismein koi padarth electron khota hai (aur uski oxidation number badh jaati hai) - ise yaad rakhne ke liye 'OIL RIG' (Oxidation Is Loss, Reduction Is Gain) ka sahara lete hain. Udaharan: Zn Zn2+ + 2e-, yahan zinc ne electron khoye isliye oxidise hua. Electron praapti (gain), proton ka aadan-pradan ya hydrogen ka nikalna - ye teeno paribhashaayein oxidation ki nahi (reduction ya acid-base ki hain), isliye inhe sahi nahi maana jaata. Exam point: oxidation = electron ka tyag (loss) aur oxidation number badhna; reduction = electron ka labh (gain) aur oxidation number ghatega.

qe: What is the 'Oxidation Number' of Manganese in the Permanganate ion ($MnO_4^-$)?
qh: परमैंगनेट आयन ($MnO_4^-$) में मैंगनीज की 'ऑक्सीकरण संख्या' क्या है?
e: MnO4- ion mein oxygen ka oxidation number -2 hota hai (4 oxygen ke liye -8), aur ion ka kul aavesh -1 hai, isliye x + (-8) = -1 se x = +7 nikalta hai - yaani manganese ka oxidation number +7 hai. Yahi karan hai ki permanganate ek prabal oxidising agent hai (Mn7+ se Mn2+ tak jaata hai, rang baingani se rang-heen). Saadhaaran galti '4' ya '6' likhna hai (oxygen ke -2 ko bhoolna), aur +2 Mn2+ ka hota hai. Exam point: MnO4- mein Mn ka oxidation number = +7; isi karan permanganate prabal oxidising agent hai.

qe: Which of the following physical characteristics is NOT a colligative property of dilute solutions?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा भौतिक लक्षण तनु विलयनों का अणुसंख्य गुणधर्म नहीं है?
e: Colligative properties (vapour pressure ka apchaalan, kvathank badaut, hiamank avana aur osmotic pressure) sirf ghule hue kanon ki sankhya par nirbhar hoti hain, islye uska aadhaar 'kan ki ginti' hai. Satah tanav (surface tension) ek aantarikmukhi (interfacial) gun hai jo kanon ki sankhya ke bajaye padarth ke rasayanik swabhav aur tapman par nirbhar karta hai, isliye ye colligative property nahi hai. Isi tarah viscosity, refractive index aur rang bhi colligative nahi hote. Exam point: colligative properties char hi hain (relative lowering of vapour pressure, elevation of boiling point, depression of freezing point, osmotic pressure); surface tension inmein nahi hai.

qe: Why is common rock salt (NaCl) scattered over snow-covered roadways in freezing winter climates?
qh: सर्दियों में बर्फीली सड़कों पर साधारण नमक (NaCl) क्यों छिड़का जाता है?
o: To cause a depression in the freezing point of water, melting the ice at sub-zero temperatures
e: Sadak par namak (NaCl) bikherne se paani ke hiamank (freezing point) mein avana (depression) hota hai, kyunki ghule hue kan (Na+ aur Cl-) paani ke ice banne ka amal rok dete hain - isliye 0 degree C se kam tapman par bhi barf pighal jaati hai aur sadak par phisalna kam hota hai. Yahi hiamank avana colligative property ka vyavharik udaharan hai (NaCl jaise ion dene wale padarth ka asar dugna hota hai). Boiling point badhna, freezing point badhna ya garmi badhana is kriya ka sahi kaaran nahi hain. Exam point: sadak par namak dalne se freezing point girta hai (freezing point depression), isliye barf kam tapman par bhi pighal kar girti hai.

qe: What is the 'Oxidation State' of Carbon in Carbon Dioxide ($CO_2$)?
qh: कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड ($CO_2$) में कार्बन की 'ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था' क्या है?
e: CO2 mein oxygen ka oxidation number -2 hota hai, aur molecule vidyut-udasheeni (neutral) hai, isliye x + 2(-2) = 0 se x = +4 nikalta hai - matlab carbon ka oxidation state +4 hai. Isi karan CO2 mein carbon apni sabse uchch (highest) oxidation avastha mein hai, isliye ye aage oxidise nahi hota (jalne ka final product banta hai) par carbon jaise reducing agent bana deta hai. 2, -2 ya 4+ (chinh galat) wale vikalp ganit se match nahi karte (oxygen chhupe aavesh ko bhoolna aam galti hai). Exam point: CO2 mein carbon ka oxidation number +4 hai (x + 2(-2) = 0), jo carbon ki sabse uchch oxidation avastha hai.

qe: A chemical reaction in which oxidation and reduction occur simultaneously across interacting species is called a:
qh: वह रासायनिक अभिक्रिया जिसमें भाग लेने वाली प्रजातियों के बीच ऑक्सीकरण और अपचयन एक साथ होते हैं, कहलाती है:
e: Aisi kriya jismein ek padarth oxidise (electron kho) aur doosra padarth reduce (electron pa) ho, use redox (reduction-oxidation) reaction kehte hain - dono kriyaayein ek saath hoti hain, kyunki electron koi khota hai to koi paata hai. Udaharan: Zn + Cu2+ Zn2+ + Cu, yahan zinc oxidise aur copper reduce hua. Isi tarah battery ka discharge aur shvasan (respiration) bhi redox kriyaayein hain, jabki acid-base ya vishleshan (precipitation) kriyaayein redox nahi (unme electron ka aadan-pradan nahi hota). Exam point: oxidation aur reduction ek saath hone wali kriya = redox reaction (electron ka aadan-pradan), jaise Zn + Cu2+ Zn2+ + Cu.

qe: What is the 'Oxidation Number' of Hydrogen in active metal hydrides like Sodium Hydride ($NaH$)?
qh: सोडियम हाइड्राइड ($NaH$) जैसे सक्रिय धातु हाइड्राइड में हाइड्रोजन की 'ऑक्सीकरण संख्या' क्या होती है?
e: Active metal hydrides jaise NaH mein sodium ka oxidation number +1 hota hai, aur hydride ion (H-) ka -1 hota hai, kyunki active dhaatu hydrogen se zyada vidyut-dhanatmak (electropositive) hoti hai aur electron de deti hai; isliye NaH mein hydrogen ka oxidation number -1 hai. Dhyan rakhein ki non-metal hydrides (HCl ya H2O) mein hydrogen +1 hota hai, aur aise hydride ion se H2 gas bhi banti hai (paani ke saath kriya kar ke). 0, +1 ya -2 wale vikalp is prashn ke liye galat hain. Exam point: active metal hydrides (NaH, CaH2, LiAlH4) mein hydrogen ka oxidation number -1 hota hai (hydride ion), jabki HCl/H2O mein +1.

qe: In the redox reaction $Zn + Cu^{2+} \rightarrow Zn^{2+} + Cu$, which chemical entity undergoes 'Reduction'?
qh: रेडॉक्स अभिक्रिया $Zn + Cu^{2+} \rightarrow Zn^{2+} + Cu$ में, किस रासायनिक स्पीशीज का 'अपचयन' (Reduction) होता है?
e: Zn + Cu2+ Zn2+ + Cu mein copper ion (Cu2+) electron praapt karke dhaatu copper (Cu) ban jaata hai, isliye Cu2+ reduce hua aur uski oxidation avastha +2 se 0 par aa gayi. Ulta zinc (Zn) electron kho kar Zn2+ ban jaata hai, isliye zinc oxidise hua - yahi karan hai ki zinc ki plate patli hoti jaati hai. 'Reduction' ka matlab electron praapti aur oxidation number ghatega hai, isliye Zn, Zn2+ aur Cu wale vikalp sahi nahi hain (Zn oxidise hota hai, Cu banta hai). Exam point: Zn + Cu2+ Zn2+ + Cu mein Cu2+ reduce (electron praapt karke) Cu banta hai; zinc oxidise hokar Zn2+ banta hai (redox reaction).

qe: What is the 'Oxidation Number' of Sulfur in Sulfuric Acid ($H_2SO_4$)?
qh: सल्फ्यूरिक एसिड ($H_2SO_4$) में सल्फर की 'ऑक्सीकरण संख्या' क्या है?
e: H2SO4 mein hydrogen +1 (2 x 1 = +2) aur oxygen -2 (4 x -2 = -8) hota hai; molecule vidyut-udasheeni hone ke karan 2 + x - 8 = 0 se x = +6 nikalta hai - yaani sulfuric acid mein sulfur ka oxidation number +6 hai, jo uski uchch (highest) oxidation avastha hai. Isi karan garam aur gaadha H2SO4 prabal oxidising agent banta hai (sulfur ko SO2 tak laata hai). +4 SO2 mein, -2 sulfide mein hota hai, aur 4/3 (thiosulfate) anya roop hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi jod nahi. Exam point: H2SO4 mein sulfur ka oxidation number = +6 (2(+1) + x + 4(-2) = 0), isliye ye sulfur ki uchch avastha hai.

qe: What is the 'Oxidation State' of Chlorine in Perchloric Acid ($HClO_4$)?
qh: परक्लोरिक एसिड ($HClO_4$) में क्लोरीन की 'ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था' क्या है?
e: HClO4 mein hydrogen +1 aur oxygen -2 hota hai; isliye 1 + x + 4(-2) = 0 se x = +7 milta hai - matlab perchloric acid mein chlorine apni sabse uchch oxidation avastha (+7) mein hai, isliye ye sabse prabal oxyacid hai (chlorine yahan pura oxidise ho chuka hai). Isi karan HClO4 (perchloric acid) prabal oxidising aur 'super acid' jaisa vyavhaar karta hai. HClO (x = +1, hypochlorous), HClO2 (+3) aur HClO3 (+5) kam oxidised roop hain, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: HClO4 mein chlorine ka oxidation state = +7 (1 + x + 4(-2) = 0), jo chlorine ki sabse uchch avastha hai.

qe: A chemical reaction in which the same element simultaneously undergoes both oxidation and reduction is called a:
qh: वह रासायनिक अभिक्रिया जिसमें एक ही तत्व का एक साथ ऑक्सीकरण और अपचयन दोनों होता है, कहलाती है:
e: Aisi kriya jismein ek hi element ek saath oxidise (electron kho) aur reduce (electron pa) ho, use disproportionation (viyojan) reaction kehte hain; jaise 2H2O2 2H2O + O2 mein oxygen ek anu mein oxidise hota hai (O2) aur doosre anu mein reduce hota hai (H2O), aur 2Cu+ Cu2+ + Cu bhi isi prakar ki hai. Isliye is kriya mein ek hi padarth apne aap ko oxidise aur reduce karta hai. Sandrata-acid base, vishleshan (precipitation) aur utpreran (catalysis) is paribhasha se jude nahi - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: ek hi element ka ek saath oxidation aur reduction = disproportionation reaction (udaharan 2H2O2 2H2O + O2).

qe: According to the Lewis definition, what is a 'Lewis Base'?
qh: लुईस परिभाषा के अनुसार, एक 'लुईस क्षार' (Lewis Base) क्या होता है?
e: Lewis ki paribhasha acid-base ko electron-jode (electron pair) ke aadan-pradan se batati hai: Lewis base wo hai jo electron joda daan (donate) karti hai (isliye usme ekant joda/ lone pair hota hai) aur Lewis acid wo jo electron joda leti hai. Isi karan NH3 H+ ko apna lone pair de kar NH4+ banata hai, isliye ammonia Lewis base hai; BF3 jaisi electron-deficient species Lewis acid hoti hai. Proton dene wale ko Bronsted acid kehte hain, OH- dene wale ko Arrhenius base - isliye ye vikalp Lewis ki paribhasha nahi hain. Exam point: Lewis base = electron pair donor (lone pair), jaise NH3, H2O aur F-; Lewis acid electron pair acceptor hota hai (BF3, AlCl3).
